description_en: Revokes the authorization of a network instance for a specified Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用RevokeInstanceFromCen撤销网络实例对指定云企业网实例的授权
kebab_example: aliyun vpc revoke-instance-from-cen --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id vpc-uf6o8d1dj8sjwxi6o0000 --instance-type VPC --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --cen-owner-id 123456789 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeInstanceFromCen

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).

VBR: Virtual Border Router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型，取值：

VPC：专有网络。

VBR：边界路由器。

CCN：云连接网
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance for which you want to revoke authorization
parameters.help_zh: 指定要撤销授权的云企业网实例的ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定要撤销授权的云企业网实例所属账号的UID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
